purpose: Informational dependency-limit and local-fix registry; not an ignore list. Includes a fresh selected CSS syntax audit, separate from rendering comparisons.
constraints: Lightning CSS remains unchanged and the only CSS parser.
No parallel CSS text parsing or replacement grammar.
Inspection of existing native ASTs and reuse of native typed value parsers is allowed.

status_definitions.blocked_under_current_constraints: Retained native observations and source inspection show necessary information lost from the AST, or a native grammar rejection with no exposed option to admit the syntax. Requires changed native behavior or provenance outside the current AST-only path. Not a permanent impossibility claim.
status_definitions.needs_investigation: A dependency boundary or missing typed representation was observed, but compliant local fixes have not been ruled out. Do not automatically skip or call unfixable.
status_definitions.engine_work_required: Missing engine, layout or adapter integration; dependency API work may help, but no hard dependency block was established.
status_definitions.local_fix_candidate: A plausible route using existing native parsers or AST validation was found. Not an implemented fix or demonstrated pass gain; valid-case regression checks remain required.
status_definitions.fixed_in_syntax_audit: An original candidate mismatch is absent from the fresh full selected syntax audit after implementation. Retained actual/native fields describe the original snapshot; resolution records the latest syntax outcome. Does not establish computed-value or image-rendering coverage.

LC-AST-INFORMATION-LOSS.evidence: Same native typed AST for two distinct source forms; an AST-only guard cannot distinguish them.
LC-AST-INFORMATION-LOSS.required_change: Native validation or retained source/form provenance; re-audit after dependency changes.

LC-SCOPE-RECOVERY-LOSS.evidence: Mixed valid/invalid @scope selector lists retain only the valid branch, with no invalid-branch marker in ScopeRule.
LC-SCOPE-RECOVERY-LOSS.required_change: Strict native scope parsing or exposed recovery diagnostics/source provenance.

LC-SLOTTED-PSEUDO-WHITELIST.evidence: Native stylesheet parsing rejects six slotted chains; valid_after_slotted has a fixed whitelist excluding these pseudo-elements. Parcel rejects them before returning an AST.
LC-SLOTTED-PSEUDO-WHITELIST.required_change: Extend native whitelist or expose parser policy; no AST-only post-validation can recover a rejected selector.

LC-SELECTOR-RECOVERY-LOSS.evidence: Native stylesheet AST dumps for :has(.a, 123) and :has(.a) match; source confirms forgiving recovery discards the invalid branch.
LC-SELECTOR-RECOVERY-LOSS.required_change: Strict native :has parsing or exposed recovery/source provenance.

rejected_collision_evidence.reason: The historical self-comparisons remain invalid proof. Fresh distinct negative-literal versus calc() comparisons now independently establish native Property equality for both keys; they are blocked on that new evidence.

Two palette descriptor cases are candidates, not confirmed impossibilities.

Do not pool assertions with rendering files, subtract them from broad-suite failures, or alter coverage denominators using this registry.
Other rendering failures and 13434 currently unsupported-capability assertions remain unclassified here.
Shapes, masking, ordinary borders, optional codecs and general paint/layout gaps are not automatically dependency blockers.
Already fixed width/slant rendering, ordinary palettes, palette fallback and runner paint order are not hard dependency blocks.
